events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the start-endy probe and list Instantly references in cloud/src
events.input: $ node cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "exit=$?"; echo ---; grep -rn -i "instantly" cloud/src | head -30; echo ---; git status --short -- cloud/src workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py workshop-plan/ops/endy-call-brief.md cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...main; echo ---; wc -l workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py workshop-plan/ops/endy-call-brief.md cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check push state, hand-off wiring, scheduled job, stale references and the Nelbin task
events.input: $ echo "== pushed?"; git branch -r --contains 80878cb | head -3; echo "== callers"; grep -n "endy_leads\|main_send\|Inbox Partner" workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.py | head -20; echo "== importers of instantly connector"; grep -rn "connectors/instantly\|from \"./instantly\"\|inMailboxes\|inWarm" cloud/src --include=*.ts -l | head; echo "== stale team inbox"; grep -rn "adi@growthclub.org" workshop-plan/ops/*.py workshop-plan/ops/*.md workshop-plan/ops/launchd 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn -i "endy" --include=*.md workshop-plan/ops scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | grep -v endy-call-brief |

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate the start-endy wait code in the Worker source
events.input: $ grep -n "tantraMailboxes\|Connected and Gmail capable\|start-endy\|start_endy" cloud/src/agentic.ts cloud/src/jobs.ts cloud/src/jobs-m365.ts cloud/src/connectors/stack.ts | cut -c1-240 | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the start-endy wait, the accounts reader, the sync caller and the job log
events.input: $ sed -n 548,580p cloud/src/jobs.ts | cut -c1-330; echo "== stack"; sed -n 640,662p cloud/src/connectors/stack.ts | cut -c1-300; echo "== agentic endy"; grep -n -i "endy\|warmup\|mail_source\|MAIL_" cloud/src/agentic.ts | cut -c1-260 | head -30; echo "== sheet"; sed -n 228,246p workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.py; echo "== log"; tail -6 /tmp/centre-sheet.log | cut -c1-200; echo "== importers"; grep -rln "connectors/instantly" cloud/src; echo "== stale inbox"; grep -rn "adi@growthclub.org" workshop-plan/ops | grep -i -v "dryrun" | cut -c1-200 | head; echo "== docs"; grep -rn -i "endy_leads\|ENDY_
